notes.title: Forsaker : DingDing&Blade Update Notes for Version 1.28
notes.content:
1.Fixed the display issue of the active skill list during battles.

2.The game has been optimized for display on 【16:10】 screen resolutions.

3.Fixed description issues for certain card attributes.

4.Fixed issues with the display of some storylines when the language is set to English.
